thread:
rachel: Heads-up 1: Customer B wants EU rollout to be opt-in and to run an A/B of quantized vs full-precision models. They also want a documented fallback that auto-evicts traffic to US when cost or latency spikes.

priya: They care about billing transparency and a clear opt-in/off path per tenant. Also asked for an audit event for any automated fallback.

lucas: Proposed plan: A/B experiment keyed by tenant id. Group A -> quantized EU model, Group B -> FP32 EU model. Start with shadowing then 2% -> 10% -> 50%.

sam: Operational constraints: EU cluster has burst limits. Need a safety circuit that checks two signals: latency_p95 and token_burn_rate. If either breaches threshold, trigger fallback.

rachel: Flag model: feature flag "eu_ab_quant_vs_fp_v1" with modes: off/shadow/ab/rollout. Rollout rules: only tenants with opt-in tag can be sampled in ab mode.

lucas: Pseudocode for assignment: 
```
if flag == 'ab':
  bucket = hash(tenant_id) % 100
  if bucket < 50: assign 'quant'
  else: assign 'fp32'
```

sam: Circuit-breaker logic: 
- monitor window = 60s
- if p95_latency > 200ms OR token_burn_delta > 15% -> start fallback.
- fallback ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% over 4 mins (1 step/min).
- emit audit event `auto_route_eviction` with reason+metrics at each step.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: ab-controller v0.3 -> staging (build 5901) :rocket:

priya: Customer ops wants a one-click console toggle to withdraw a tenant from the experiment and to request immediate reserved capacity (if paying). Can we show estimated cost delta per tenant in UI?

lucas: We can show estimated token cost delta using historical traffic sample. That will be an analytics job (P1). For canary we can return a static estimate.

rachel: Launch gates for GA: (a) 5 business days of stable p95 < 180ms for sampled tenants, (b) error rate < 0.3%, (c) audit events for all auto actions, (d) console toggle + tenant-level opt-out.

sam: Add warm-up step: run synthetic prefix requests to all EU shards during shadow to populate KV cache and reduce cold-starts. Also ensure model caching TTL config is sane.

lucas: Rollback helper script (dry-run option): 
```
steps = [75,50,25,0]
for w in steps:
  set_eu_traffic_weight(w)
  log_audit('auto_route_eviction', weight=w, snapshot=metrics())
  sleep(60)
```

priya: I'll draft customer comms: opt-in instructions, expected behavior, and how to request reserved capacity.

rachel: Scope note: Customer asked for per-tenant SLA. We should offer "priority reserved slice" for paid tenants; otherwise default best-effort with the auto-fallback described.

sam: Runbook owners: SRE owns circuit-breaker definitions & alerts, Eng owns ab-controller and weight scripts, CS owns customer-facing opt-in docs.

lucas: I'll add `--dry-run` to ab-controller to avoid touching live weights during rehearsal. Also will emit `audit:dry_run` events.

ops-bot: ab-controller v0.3 deployed to staging successfully (5901) :white_check_mark:

rachel: Action items: @lucas implement dry-run + audit events; @sam codify circuit-breaker thresholds & add alerts; @priya prep comms + per-tenant billing estimate; I'll write the GA gating doc and share for review.

priya: Ping me once dry-run exists, I'll run through with customer.

sam: Will post runbook link when ready.

rachel: Thanks team. 10m check tomorrow after first staging dry-run.
